_note: Expectations pin BANDS and a few must-flag rule IDs, not all verdicts — full verdict-level goldens would be brittle against harmless model variation. Rule IDs are pinned to the committed data/rules.json; re-running extract may renumber them.

rocket.txt.why: Misleading return promise ('get rich tomorrow') and emotional/excitement exploitation (🚀). No risk warning.

borderline.txt.why: Clean, balanced promo (risk warning present, costs pointed to) with exactly one unverifiable promotional claim — the '30 million users' figure. Expect needs_review on it (acceptable if true, so neither compliant-on-trust nor non_compliant-on-suspicion). Earlier fixture versions stacked three superlatives and sat ON the WARN/FAIL boundary — bistable across runs; fixtures must sit inside a band, not on a line.

compliant.txt.why: Balanced description, costs disclosed, prominent capital-at-risk warning, anti-pressure language. Note: contains the red-flag-adjacent phrase 'Take your time' — a keyword-matcher would misfire; a judge should not.
